gas_grenade.name: Gas Grenade
gas_grenade.description: Release poison gas that affects both players, dealing 1 damage at the end of each turn for 10 turns.

antidote.name: Antidote
antidote.description: Removes all poison status effects from the user.

gas_mask.name: Gas Mask
gas_mask.description: Applies a gas mask status effect that negates poison applications.

poison_drink.name: Poison Drink
poison_drink.description: Applies a high number of poison charges to the user.

poison_darts.name: Poison Darts
poison_darts.description: Deal 2 damage and apply 2 poison to the enemy. Can be used 3 times.
